privacy.intro: Diese Datenschutzerklärung beschreibt, wie AstroDating Ihre personenbezogenen Daten erhebt, nutzt und schützt, wenn Sie die mobile Anwendung AstroDating (die 'App') nutzen. Sie erklärt, welche Informationen wir sammeln, wie wir sie verarbeiten, mit wem wir sie teilen und welche Rechte Sie in Bezug auf Ihre Daten haben.

privacy.s1_3_social: Social-Login-Anbieter — Wenn Sie sich mit Google, Apple oder Facebook anmelden, erhalten wir Ihren Namen und Ihre E-Mail-Adresse (und, falls verfügbar, Ihr Profilfoto) gemäß den Bestimmungen des Anbieters.
privacy.s1_3_geo: Geokodierung — Wir verwenden OpenStreetMap / Nominatim, um Städtenamen in Koordinaten umzuwandeln. Bei diesen Anfragen werden keine personenbezogenen Daten übermittelt.
privacy.s2_provide: Bereitstellung des Dienstes — Erstellung Ihres Kontos, Anzeige Ihres Profils, Berechnung Ihres Geburtshoroskops, Ermittlung von Kompatibilitätswerten, Ermöglichung von Matching und Messaging.
privacy.s2_personalize: Personalisierung — Anzeige von Profilen, die Ihren Entdeckungseinstellungen und Ihrer astrologischen Kompatibilität entsprechen.
privacy.s2_safety: Sicherheit & Integrität — Erkennung und Verhinderung von Betrug, Durchsetzung unserer Nutzungsbedingungen sowie Bearbeitung von Sperr- und Meldeaktionen.
privacy.s2_comm: Kommunikation — Senden von Push-Benachrichtigungen über neue Matches, Nachrichten und wichtige Service-Updates.
privacy.s2_subs: Abonnements — Verarbeitung und Verwaltung von Premium-Abonnements und In-App-Käufen über RevenueCat; Nachverfolgung von Feature-Berechtigungen und Testnutzung.
privacy.s2_improve: Verbesserung & Analyse — Analyse von Nutzungsmustern, Diagnose von Abstürzen (über Sentry) und Verbesserung der App.
privacy.s2_legal: Rechtliche Einhaltung — Beantwortung rechtmäßiger Anfragen von Behörden und Durchsetzung unserer Rechte.
privacy.s3_intro: Einige der von Ihnen bereitgestellten Informationen können nach geltendem Recht als sensibel gelten, darunter:
privacy.s3_note: Diese Daten werden freiwillig bereitgestellt und ausschließlich zur Erbringung der Kernfunktionen der App verwendet (Geburtshoroskop-Berechnung, Kompatibilitäts-Matching, entfernungsbasierte Entdeckung). Wir verkaufen keine sensiblen Daten und verwenden sie nicht für Werbung.
privacy.s4_1_text: Ihre Profilinformationen (Name, Alter, Fotos, Biografie, Beruf, Interessen, Sternzeichen, Kompatibilitätswert) sind für andere Nutzer bei der Entdeckung und nach einem Match sichtbar. Ihr genauer Standort wird niemals angezeigt; es wird nur eine ungefähre Entfernung dargestellt. Nachrichteninhalte sind nur für Sie und den Empfänger sichtbar.
privacy.s4_2_note: Jeder Anbieter verarbeitet Daten ausschließlich in unserem Auftrag und unter vertraglichen Verpflichtungen zu deren Schutz.
privacy.s4_3_text: Wir können Ihre Daten offenlegen, wenn dies gesetzlich vorgeschrieben ist, aufgrund von Vorschriften, Gerichtsverfahren oder behördlichen Anfragen, oder um die Rechte, die Sicherheit oder das Eigentum von AstroDating, unseren Nutzern oder der Öffentlichkeit zu schützen.
privacy.s4_4_text: Falls AstroDating an einer Fusion, Übernahme oder einem Verkauf von Vermögenswerten beteiligt ist, können Ihre personenbezogenen Daten im Rahmen dieser Transaktion übertragen werden. Wir werden Sie über eine solche Änderung informieren.
privacy.s5_active: Aktive Konten — Wir bewahren Ihre Daten auf, solange Ihr Konto aktiv ist und dies für die Erbringung des Dienstes erforderlich ist.
privacy.s5_deleted: Gelöschte Konten — Wenn Sie Ihr Konto löschen, löschen oder anonymisieren wir Ihre personenbezogenen Daten innerhalb von 30 Tagen, es sei denn, eine Aufbewahrung ist gesetzlich vorgeschrieben oder zur Beilegung von Streitigkeiten erforderlich.
privacy.s5_messages: Nachrichten — Nachrichten werden gelöscht, wenn beide Teilnehmer ihre Konten gelöscht haben oder das Match aufgehoben wurde.
privacy.s5_crash: Absturzberichte — Sentry-Daten werden bis zu 90 Tage aufbewahrt.
privacy.s5_legal: Gesetzliche Aufbewahrung — Daten können länger aufbewahrt werden, wenn dies für laufende Gerichtsverfahren oder regulatorische Verpflichtungen erforderlich ist.
privacy.s6_intro: Wir setzen branchenübliche Maßnahmen zum Schutz Ihrer Daten ein, darunter:
privacy.s6_tls: Verschlüsselung bei der Übertragung (TLS/HTTPS für alle API-Kommunikation)
privacy.s6_rest: Verschlüsselung gespeicherter Daten im Ruhezustand (von Supabase verwaltete Verschlüsselung)
privacy.s6_rls: Row-Level-Security-Richtlinien in der Datenbank zur Verhinderung unbefugter Zugriffe
privacy.s6_hash: Passwort-Hashing (wird von Supabase Auth verwaltet; wir speichern niemals Passwörter im Klartext)
privacy.s6_note: Kein System ist vollständig sicher. Obwohl wir bestrebt sind, Ihre Daten zu schützen, können wir keine absolute Sicherheit garantieren.
privacy.s7_intro: Je nach Ihrer Rechtsordnung können Ihnen folgende Rechte zustehen:
privacy.s7_access: Auskunft — Fordern Sie eine Kopie der personenbezogenen Daten an, die wir über Sie gespeichert haben.
privacy.s7_correction: Berichtigung — Fordern Sie die Korrektur unrichtiger oder unvollständiger Daten an.
privacy.s7_deletion: Löschung — Fordern Sie die Löschung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten an.
privacy.s7_portability: Datenübertragbarkeit — Erhalten Sie Ihre Daten in einem strukturierten, maschinenlesbaren Format.
privacy.s7_objection: Widerspruch / Einschränkung — Widersprechen Sie bestimmten Verarbeitungsaktivitäten oder fordern Sie deren Einschränkung an.
privacy.s7_withdraw: Widerruf der Einwilligung — Sofern die Verarbeitung auf einer Einwilligung beruht, können Sie diese jederzeit widerrufen, ohne dass die Rechtmäßigkeit der zuvor erfolgten Verarbeitung berührt wird.
privacy.s7_ctrl1: Bearbeiten oder löschen Sie Ihre Profilinformationen jederzeit über den Profil-Tab.
privacy.s7_ctrl2: Passen Sie Entdeckungseinstellungen (Alter, Entfernung, Sternzeichen-Filter) in den Einstellungen an.
privacy.s7_ctrl3: Blockieren Sie jeden Nutzer, um weitere Interaktionen zu verhindern.
privacy.s7_ctrl4: Löschen Sie Ihr Konto über den Einstellungen-Bildschirm, wodurch die Entfernung Ihrer Daten ausgelöst wird.
privacy.s7_ctrl5: Verwalten Sie Push-Benachrichtigungsberechtigungen über Ihre Geräteeinstellungen.
privacy.s7_ccpa_intro: Wenn Sie in Kalifornien ansässig sind, haben Sie gemäß dem California Consumer Privacy Act zusätzliche Rechte, darunter:
privacy.s7_ccpa1: Das Recht zu erfahren, welche personenbezogenen Daten wir erheben und wie sie verwendet werden.
privacy.s7_ccpa2: Das Recht, die Löschung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten zu verlangen.
privacy.s7_ccpa3: Das Recht, dem „Verkauf“ oder der „Weitergabe“ personenbezogener Daten zu widersprechen. Wir verkaufen Ihre personenbezogenen Daten nicht.
privacy.s7_ccpa4: Das Recht auf Nichtdiskriminierung bei der Ausübung Ihrer Datenschutzrechte.
privacy.s7_gdpr_intro: Wenn Sie sich im Europäischen Wirtschaftsraum oder im Vereinigten Königreich befinden, sind unsere Rechtsgrundlagen für die Verarbeitung nachstehend aufgeführt. Sie haben außerdem das Recht, eine Beschwerde bei Ihrer zuständigen Datenschutzbehörde einzureichen.
privacy.s7_profiling_intro: AstroDating verwendet automatisierte Verarbeitung zur Berechnung von Kompatibilitätswerten zwischen Nutzern. So funktioniert es:
privacy.s7_profiling_what: Was wir tun: Wir analysieren Ihre Geburtshoroskop-Daten (Planetenpositionen, Häuser, Aspekte) zusammen mit denen anderer Nutzer mithilfe astrologischer Synastrie-Algorithmen, um einen Kompatibilitätsprozentsatz zu ermitteln.
privacy.s7_profiling_impact: Auswirkung: Der Kompatibilitätswert beeinflusst die Reihenfolge, in der Profile in Ihrem Entdeckungs-Feed erscheinen. Profile mit höheren Kompatibilitätswerten werden zuerst angezeigt. Dies beeinträchtigt nicht Ihre Möglichkeit, Profile zu sehen oder Kontakt aufzunehmen — alle Nutzer bleiben zugänglich.
privacy.s7_profiling_logic: Verwendete Logik: Der Algorithmus bewertet planetare Aspekte (Konjunktionen, Trigone, Quadrate, Oppositionen, Sextile) zwischen Ihrem und anderen Horoskopen, mit besonderer Gewichtung persönlicher Planeten (Sonne, Mond, Venus, Mars) und Beziehungshäuser (5., 7., 8.).
privacy.s7_profiling_rights: Ihre Rechte: Gemäß DSGVO Artikel 22 haben Sie das Recht, eine menschliche Überprüfung von Entscheidungen zu verlangen, die Sie erheblich betreffen, Ihren Standpunkt darzulegen und die Entscheidung anzufechten. Sie können uns kontaktieren, um eine manuelle Überprüfung Ihrer Kompatibilitätsberechnungen zu beantragen.
privacy.s7_profiling_withdraw: Sie können Ihre Einwilligung zum Profiling jederzeit durch Löschung Ihres Kontos widerrufen. Beachten Sie, dass die Kompatibilitätsbewertung eine Kernfunktion ist; ihre Deaktivierung würde die Funktionsweise der App wie vorgesehen verhindern.
privacy.s8_text: Ihre Daten können in anderen Ländern als Ihrem eigenen verarbeitet werden. Soweit erforderlich, stützen wir uns auf Standardvertragsklauseln oder andere gesetzlich zugelassene Übermittlungsmechanismen, um ein angemessenes Schutzniveau zu gewährleisten.
privacy.s9_text: AstroDating richtet sich an Nutzer ab 18 Jahren. Wir erheben wissentlich keine personenbezogenen Daten von Personen unter 18 Jahren. Sollten wir erfahren, dass ein Nutzer unter 18 Jahre alt ist, werden wir sein Konto und die zugehörigen Daten umgehend löschen. Wenn Sie glauben, dass ein Minderjähriger ein Konto erstellt hat, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte umgehend.
privacy.s10_text: Die App kann Links zu Websites oder Diensten Dritter enthalten. Diese Datenschutzerklärung gilt nicht für diese Dienste, und wir empfehlen Ihnen, deren Datenschutzrichtlinien unabhängig zu überprüfen.
privacy.s11_text: Wir können diese Datenschutzerklärung von Zeit zu Zeit aktualisieren. Bei wesentlichen Änderungen werden wir Sie über die App oder per E-Mail benachrichtigen, bevor die Änderungen wirksam werden. Das Datum „Zuletzt aktualisiert“ oben auf dieser Seite gibt an, wann die Richtlinie zuletzt überarbeitet wurde. Die fortgesetzte Nutzung der App nach dem Inkrafttreten stellt die Annahme der aktualisierten Richtlinie dar.
privacy.s12_text: Wenn Sie Fragen zu dieser Datenschutzerklärung haben oder Ihre Datenschutzrechte ausüben möchten, kontaktieren Sie uns unter:
privacy.s12_exercise: So üben Sie Ihre Rechte aus
privacy.s12_exercise_intro: Um einen Antrag auf Datenzugang, -löschung, -berichtigung oder -übertragbarkeit einzureichen:
privacy.s12_exercise1: Senden Sie uns eine E-Mail an privacy@astrodatingapp.com mit Ihrem Antrag.
privacy.s12_exercise2: Wir werden Ihre Identität überprüfen, indem wir die E-Mail-Adresse Ihres Antrags mit Ihrem registrierten Konto abgleichen oder bei Bedarf zusätzliche Informationen anfordern.
privacy.s12_exercise3: Für Anträge im Namen einer anderen Person benötigen wir eine schriftliche Genehmigung der betroffenen Person und einen Identitätsnachweis.
privacy.s12_timeline_gdpr: EWR/UK (DSGVO): Wir antworten innerhalb von 30 Tagen. Komplexe Anfragen können mit vorheriger Ankündigung um weitere 60 Tage verlängert werden.
privacy.s12_timeline_ccpa: Kalifornien (CCPA/CPRA): Wir antworten innerhalb von 45 Tagen. Komplexe Anfragen können mit vorheriger Ankündigung um weitere 45 Tage verlängert werden.
privacy.s12_timeline_other: Andere Rechtsordnungen: Wir bemühen uns, innerhalb von 30 Tagen zu antworten.
privacy.s12_appeals: Wenn Sie mit unserer Antwort nicht zufrieden sind, können Sie sich an Ihre zuständige Datenschutzbehörde wenden oder eine Beschwerde einreichen.
privacy.s12_response: Wir bemühen uns, alle allgemeinen Anfragen innerhalb von 30 Tagen zu beantworten.

help.stillNeedHelpDesc: Sie finden nicht, wonach Sie suchen? Wenden Sie sich an unser Support-Team.
help.a_createAccount: Lade AstroDating aus dem Google Play Store herunter oder besuche astrodatingapp.com. Registriere dich mit deiner E-Mail, Google oder Facebook (Apple-Anmeldung ist auf iOS und im Web verfügbar). Du musst dein Geburtsdatum, deine Geburtszeit und deinen Geburtsort eingeben, um dein Geburtshoroskop zu erstellen.
help.q_changeBirthTime: Kann ich meine Geburtszeit nach der Anmeldung ändern?
help.a_changeBirthTime: Ja. Gehen Sie zu Profil > Profil bearbeiten > Geburtsdaten. Beachten Sie, dass eine Änderung Ihrer Geburtszeit Ihr gesamtes Geburtshoroskop neu berechnet und Ihre Kompatibilitätswerte mit anderen Nutzern verändern kann.
help.a_deleteAccount: Sie können Ihr Konto unter Einstellungen > Konto > Konto löschen in der App löschen oder astrodatingapp.com/account/delete besuchen. Ihre Daten werden innerhalb von 30 Tagen dauerhaft entfernt.
help.a_compatibility: Wir verwenden echte Synastrie — die astrologische Praxis des Vergleichs zweier Geburtshoroskope. Wir analysieren die Aspekte zwischen Ihren Planeten und denen der anderen Person (Konjunktionen, Trigone, Quadrate usw.) über wichtige Beziehungshäuser hinweg, um einen Gesamtkompatibilitätswert zu erstellen.
help.q_fewMatches: Warum sehe ich nur wenige Matches?
help.a_fewMatches: Versuchen Sie, Ihre Entdeckungseinstellungen zu erweitern: Erhöhen Sie den Entfernungsbereich, erweitern Sie den Altersbereich oder senken Sie die Mindestkompatibilitätsschwelle. Sie können auch bestimmte Sternzeichen- oder Element-Filter entfernen.
help.a_manageSub: Das hängt davon ab, wo du dein Abo abgeschlossen hast. Auf Android verwaltest du es über die Google Play Abo-Einstellungen. Im Web gehe zu Einstellungen > Abrechnung, um auf dein Stripe-Portal zuzugreifen, wo du dein Abo ändern oder kündigen kannst.
help.a_refund: Für Google Play Abos werden Rückerstattungen von Google gemäß deren Richtlinien bearbeitet. Für Web-Abos (Stripe) kontaktiere unser Team über das Kontaktformular. Wir prüfen Anfragen im Einzelfall.
help.a_autoRenew: Ja. Abonnements verlängern sich automatisch, sofern sie nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des aktuellen Zeitraums gekündigt werden. Du kannst jederzeit über die Google Play Einstellungen (Android) oder die Abrechnungsseite der Web-App kündigen.
help.a_report: Tippen Sie auf das Dreipunktmenü auf einem beliebigen Profil oder in einer Chat-Konversation und wählen Sie dann „Melden“. Wählen Sie einen Grund und fügen Sie Details hinzu. Unser Team überprüft alle Meldungen innerhalb von 24 Stunden.
help.a_block: Tippen Sie auf das Dreipunktmenü auf dem Profil der Person oder in Ihrem Chat und wählen Sie dann „Blockieren“. Die Person kann Ihr Profil nicht mehr sehen oder Sie kontaktieren und wird nicht benachrichtigt.
help.q_locationShared: Wird mein Standort mit anderen Nutzern geteilt?
help.a_locationShared: Es wird nur Ihre ungefähre Entfernung angezeigt (z. B. „5 km entfernt“). Ihre genauen Koordinaten sind für andere Nutzer niemals sichtbar.
help.q_birthTime: Muss ich meine genaue Geburtszeit kennen?
help.a_birthTime: Für das genaueste Horoskop, ja. Ihre Geburtszeit bestimmt Ihren Aszendenten und die Häuserverteilung, die die Kompatibilitätswerte erheblich beeinflussen. Wenn Sie Ihre genaue Uhrzeit nicht kennen, können Sie eine ungefähre Zeit eingeben — allerdings werden Ihr Horoskop und Ihre Werte weniger genau sein.
help.q_sunVsFull: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen Sonnenzeichen- und Vollhoroskop-Kompatibilität?
help.a_sunVsFull: Die Sonnenzeichen-Kompatibilität berücksichtigt nur einen Planeten. Die Vollhoroskop-Kompatibilität (Synastrie) analysiert alle Planetenstellungen, Aspekte und Häuserüberlagerungen zwischen zwei Horoskopen — und liefert so ein wesentlich differenzierteres und genaueres Bild der Beziehungsdynamik.
help.a_personalizedHoroscopes: Ja. Im Gegensatz zu allgemeinen Horoskopen, die nur auf Ihrem Sonnenzeichen basieren, werden unsere Horoskope aus Ihrem vollständigen Geburtshoroskop berechnet, einschließlich Transiten zu Ihrem Mond, Aszendenten, Ihrer Venus und anderen wichtigen Platzierungen.
help.a_promoCode: Auf Android gehe zum Pläne-Bildschirm und gib deinen Code ein, bevor du einen Plan auswählst. Im Web gib den Code auf der Checkout-Seite ein. Promo-Codes bieten je nach Kampagne Rabatte oder Bonusmonate.
help.q_webApp: Kann ich AstroDating am Computer nutzen?
help.a_webApp: Ja! Besuche app.astrodatingapp.com, um die vollständige Web-App zu nutzen. Du kannst Profile durchsuchen, mit Matches chatten, dein Geburtshoroskop ansehen und dein Abo verwalten — alles im Browser.
help.q_installPwa: Kann ich die Web-App auf meinem Handy installieren?
help.a_installPwa: Ja. Besuche astrodatingapp.com in deinem mobilen Browser und tippe auf 'Zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen'. Die App erscheint als Symbol auf deinem Startbildschirm und öffnet sich im Vollbildmodus.
help.q_webSync: Werden meine Daten zwischen App und Web synchronisiert?
help.a_webSync: Ja. Dein Profil, Matches, Nachrichten und Abo werden in Echtzeit synchronisiert. Du kannst nahtlos zwischen der mobilen App und der Web-App wechseln.

safety.title: Sicherheit und Community-Standards
safety.effectiveDate: Gültig ab: 10. Februar 2026 — Zuletzt aktualisiert: 10. Februar 2026
safety.intro: AstroDating ist der Schaffung einer sicheren Umgebung für alle Nutzer verpflichtet. Wir haben strenge Richtlinien gegen Kindesmissbrauch, Belästigung und Missbrauch. Diese Seite beschreibt unsere Sicherheitsstandards und Meldeverfahren.
safety.s1_intro: AstroDating ist ausschließlich für Erwachsene ab 18 Jahren bestimmt. Wir haben eine Null-Toleranz-Politik für jeden Inhalt oder jedes Verhalten, das Minderjährige ausbeutet, gefährdet oder sexualisiert.
safety.s1_zeroTolerance: NULL-TOLERANZ: Jeder Verstoß gegen unsere Kinderschutzrichtlinien führt zur sofortigen Kontokündigung und Meldung an die Strafverfolgungsbehörden.
safety.s1_csam: Material über sexuellen Kindesmissbrauch (CSAM) ist streng verboten und wird dem NCMEC und den Strafverfolgungsbehörden gemeldet.
safety.s1_exploitation: Jeglicher Inhalt, der die Ausbeutung von Kindern darstellt, fördert oder ermöglicht, ist verboten.
safety.s1_minors: Nutzer unter 18 Jahren sind auf der Plattform nicht erlaubt.
safety.s1_grooming: Jeder Versuch, Minderjährige zu kontaktieren, anzuwerben oder zu manipulieren, führt zu einem dauerhaften Verbot und einer Benachrichtigung der Strafverfolgungsbehörden.
safety.s2_intro: Wir setzen mehrere Maßnahmen um, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Nutzer volljährig sind:
safety.s2_age18: Alle Nutzer müssen bei der Registrierung bestätigen, dass sie mindestens 18 Jahre alt sind.
safety.s2_verification: Wir können jederzeit eine zusätzliche Altersverifikation anfordern.
safety.s2_termination: Konten, bei denen der Verdacht besteht, dass sie Minderjährigen gehören, werden sofort gesperrt, bis eine Überprüfung erfolgt.
safety.s3_intro: Wir setzen umfassende Sicherheitsmaßnahmen zum Schutz unserer Community ein:
safety.s3_reporting: In-App-Meldesystem für unangemessene Inhalte und Verhaltensweisen
safety.s3_ncmec: Partnerschaft mit NCMEC (National Center for Missing & Exploited Children) zur Meldung illegaler Inhalte
safety.s4_intro: Wenn Sie besorgniserregende Inhalte oder Verhaltensweisen entdecken, melden Sie diese bitte umgehend:
safety.s4_inApp: Nutzen Sie die In-App-Meldefunktion (tippen Sie auf das Dreipunktmenü in jedem Profil oder Chat)
safety.s4_email: Kontaktieren Sie unser Sicherheitsteam direkt per E-Mail bei dringenden Anliegen
safety.s5_intro: Alle Nutzer müssen sich an unsere Community-Richtlinien halten:
safety.s5_respect: Behandeln Sie alle Nutzer mit Respekt und Würde
safety.s5_authentic: Verwenden Sie nur Ihre eigenen Fotos und geben Sie genaue Informationen an
safety.s5_noHarassment: Keine Belästigung, Mobbing oder bedrohliches Verhalten
safety.s5_noHate: Keine Hassrede, Diskriminierung oder anstößige Inhalte
safety.s5_noExplicit: Keine expliziten oder pornografischen Inhalte in öffentlichen Profilen
safety.s6_intro: AstroDating hält alle geltenden Gesetze zum Kinderschutz und zur Online-Sicherheit ein:
safety.s6_laws: Wir halten uns an COPPA, CSAM-Meldeanforderungen und internationale Kinderschutzgesetze.
safety.s6_ncmec: Wir melden alle entdeckten CSAM an die CyberTipline des NCMEC gemäß den gesetzlichen Anforderungen.
safety.s6_cooperation: Wir arbeiten vollständig mit Strafverfolgungsbehörden bei Ermittlungen zum Kinderschutz zusammen.
safety.s7_text: Bei Sicherheitsbedenken oder zur Meldung von Verstößen wenden Sie sich an unser spezialisiertes Sicherheitsteam:
safety.s7_response: Wir priorisieren Sicherheitsmeldungen und bemühen uns, innerhalb von 24 Stunden zu antworten. Dringende Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit dem Kinderschutz werden sofort bearbeitet.

webApp.planetaryTransitBody_moon: Der Mond-Transit verstärkt Empfindsamkeit, Instinkt und das emotionale Klima, das deine unmittelbaren Reaktionen formt.
webApp.planetaryTransitBody_saturn: Saturn festigt Struktur, Verantwortung, Geduld und die Arbeit, die für langfristigen Fortschritt nötig ist.
webApp.planetaryTransitBody_sun: Der Sonnen-Transit schärft Identität, Selbstvertrauen und wie klar du deine Prioritäten diesen Monat vorantreiben kannst.
webApp.planetaryTransitBody_venus: Venus färbt Romantik, Genuss, Finanzen und die Art sozialer Leichtigkeit, die gerade verfügbar ist.
webApp.planetaryTransitUpcomingBody_jupiter: Ein Jupiter-Wechsel eröffnet eine neue Wachstumsgeschichte und weitet oft Selbstvertrauen, Glück und Weitblick aus.
webApp.planetaryTransitUpcomingBody_mars: Ein Mars-Wechsel verändert deinen Antriebsstil, dein Druckniveau und die Art von Aktion, die am effektivsten wirkt.
webApp.planetaryTransitUpcomingBody_mercury: Dieser Wechsel verändert, wie Ideen fließen, wie direkt Kommunikation sich anfühlt und wo der Fokus schärfer wird.
webApp.planetaryTransitUpcomingBody_moon: Der Mondwechsel verändert den emotionalen Rhythmus schnell – nützlich fürs Timing innerer Arbeit und Verbindung.

webApp.planetaryTransitUpcomingBody_venus: Diese kommende Venus-Bewegung kann soziale Dynamiken weicher machen oder Anziehung intensivieren, je nach Timing.

webApp.dailyHoroscopeV2NoSignBody: Your Daily Horoscope tunes to your Sun sign. We don't have one on file yet — open your profile to add a birth date and unlock a personal read.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_aries: Today asks Aries to use that quickness on purpose. Move fast where it matters, slow down where someone needs to be heard. The fire is real — it lands better with a moment of patience attached.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_taurus: Today asks Taurus to trust the slower pace. The things worth building rarely come fast, and the body usually knows when to pause. Choose what feels solid over what feels exciting, even if only for the next hour.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_gemini: Today asks Gemini to pick one thread and stay on it for a while. Curiosity is a gift, but depth is where the conversation actually changes. One real exchange may beat ten brief ones.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_cancer: Today asks Cancer to mind the inner weather. Mood tends to lead here, and that's fine — but check whose mood you're carrying. Some of what feels heavy may belong to someone else.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_leo: Today asks Leo to give warmth without needing a return. Generosity reads strongest when it isn't watching for applause. The shine you don't notice is often the one people remember.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_virgo: Today asks Virgo to let one thing be imperfect. Precision is a real strength here, but it can quietly turn into a self-tax. Done is sometimes more useful than refined.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_libra: Today asks Libra to choose, even slightly. Balance is the gift, but balance held too long becomes stalling. Picking a side gently is still picking.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_scorpio: Today asks Scorpio to say the quiet thing. The depth is already there — putting it into words is the harder part. Honest beats hidden today, even if honest is uncomfortable.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_sagittarius: Today asks Sagittarius to land a little. The horizon is calling, fine — but the people in front of you may need full presence first. Travel can wait until after the conversation.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_capricorn: Today asks Capricorn to let competence rest for a moment. The plan can hold without your full grip on it. The world will not collapse if you take a slow evening.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_aquarius: Today asks Aquarius to come a little closer in. Independence stays intact — closeness doesn't cancel it. Let someone see the part that doesn't usually get shown.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeLensV2_pisces: Today asks Pisces to stay in your own water. Empathy is real here, but it can absorb. Notice where your feelings end and someone else's begin.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_aries: If you're dating today, the honest version of yourself reads better than the smooth one — Aries shines when it doesn't rehearse.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_taurus: If you're dating today, lean into the steady — a slow, present hour with someone may carry more than three quick ones.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_gemini: If you're dating today, let the conversation breathe — silence between two curious people is still part of the date.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_cancer: If you're dating today, the small care moves first — a check-in text may land deeper than a grand gesture.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_leo: If you're dating today, let yourself be chosen, not just chosen back — receiving attention is also part of the offer.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_virgo: If you're dating today, drop the mental edit — the message you almost sent is usually the one that lands.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_libra: If you're dating today, choose a real preference out loud — keeping things easy for the other person can quietly become invisible.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_scorpio: If you're dating today, say the layer underneath — Scorpio reads as too intense when it hides, not when it shows.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_sagittarius: If you're dating today, let the freedom be visible — but stay through the slower part of the conversation.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_capricorn: If you're dating today, soften the structure a notch — keeping your word matters, but spontaneity is allowed too.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_aquarius: If you're dating today, let warmth in alongside the independence — distance can be a habit, not a need.
webApp.dailyHoroscopeDatingLensV2_pisces: If you're dating today, name what you feel before you absorb what they feel — your impressions count first.

webApp.dailyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_tauru: Ask someone: "What's a small, ordinary thing that always feels like home to you?"

webApp.dailyHoroscopeConversationPromptV2_scorp: Ask someone: "What's something you've been hiding that wouldn't actually scare anyone?"

webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_aries: Where are you charging when you could be choosing? Where are you choosing when you should be charging?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_taurus: What in your day still feels like it belongs to someone else's pace? What would slowing down by ten percent give you back?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_gemini: Which of the threads you're holding actually matters this week? Which one are you keeping just because you started it?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_cancer: Whose mood is in the room with you right now? Which part of it is actually yours?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_leo: What would feel like real recognition this week — and have you let anyone close enough to give it?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_virgo: What's one thing you're refining that's already good enough? What would you do with the time you'd get back?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_libra: Which decision are you postponing because every option is acceptable? Which one are you avoiding because the right one is hard?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_scorpio: What's the unsaid thing in your closest relationship right now? What would shift if you said it out loud?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_sagittarius: Where are you reaching for the next horizon to avoid the one in front of you?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_capricorn: What in your week is structure protecting you from feeling? What would relax if you let it?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_aquarius: Where are you using independence as a wall? Where are you using it as a window?
webApp.dailyHoroscopeReflectV2_pisces: What did you absorb today that wasn't yours to carry? Where can you set it down before tonight?
webApp.natalChartDisclaimerBody: Read each placement as one piece of the whole chart. Astrology works best as a pattern language, not a fixed label.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_sun: The Sun describes your core identity, direction, and the energy you naturally radiate.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_moon: The Moon describes your emotional rhythm — what soothes you, what triggers you, what you need to feel safe.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_rising: The Rising describes how you arrive in a room — first impressions, visible style, the way you enter new situations.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_mercury: Mercury describes how you think, speak, and process information.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_venus: Venus describes how you love, attract, and what feels like care to you.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_mars: Mars describes how you go after what you want — drive, anger, desire, momentum.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_jupiter: Jupiter describes how you expand, learn, find meaning, and look for the bigger picture.
webApp.natalPlanetMeaning_saturn: Saturn describes where you build structure, take responsibility, and where things tend to take time.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_aries: In Aries, it can show a direct, fast-moving communication style — quick to initiate, honest, and sometimes impatient with long preambles. Decisions land fast; small talk feels like friction.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_taurus: In Taurus, Venus can prefer slow, sensual, reliable affection. Gestures matter more than declarations. Comfort and consistency may feel like the truest signs of love.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_cancer: In Cancer, the Moon is at home. Emotions can run deep, memory holds tight, and the urge to nurture (or be nurtured) is strong. Mood may track the people you love more than the weather.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_leo: In Leo, Mars can act with confidence, warmth, and a flair for the dramatic. Effort tends to be visible. May fight for what feels personal more than for what is strictly useful.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mercury_aries: May prefer clear, bold messages over vague hints. Tends to tell the truth fast — sometimes faster than the other person is ready for. Likes a partner who answers directly and doesn't punish the speed.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_taurus: In Taurus, Mercury can slow the mind down on purpose — deliberate, sensory, careful with words. Conclusions tend to form once they feel earned, not because someone asked for them fast. May resist being rushed.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_gemini: In Gemini, the mind tends to move fast and wide — many tabs open at once, curiosity as the default setting. Conversation can feel like its own pleasure. Decisions may benefit from a second pass after the first burst.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_cancer: In Cancer, thinking can travel through feeling first. Memory holds tightly, especially around tone. May read between lines well, sometimes too well — assuming meaning that wasn't intended.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_aries: In Aries, Venus tends to go after attraction the way it wants to be wanted: directly. May initiate, lose interest if pursuit becomes too easy, and re-engage on a spark. Often honest about preferences before the other person is ready to hear them.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_gemini: In Gemini, Venus can love through words — banter, curiosity, the buzz of a good back-and-forth. Variety may feel like care; sameness may feel like settling. Attention can shift quickly between connections.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_cancer: In Cancer, Venus loves through care — feeding, remembering, holding space. May test for safety before fully showing up, then go all in once the read feels solid.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_aries: In Aries, Mars is at home — fast off the line, direct about wanting, allergic to passivity. Anger may rise quickly and pass quickly too. Action tends to come before deliberation.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_taurus: In Taurus, Mars conserves energy. Slow to start, hard to stop. Effort tends to be steady and physical. Desire is often more practical than dramatic — what feels good, what holds up over time.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mars_cancer: In Cancer, Mars can go after what it wants sideways. Direct confrontation may feel risky; protecting loved ones may feel non-negotiable. Anger can swallow itself, then resurface as mood.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_aries: In Aries, the Moon feels things fast and clean. Emotions can land like weather — intense, then gone. May surprise people with how openly the heat shows, then move on while others are still digesting.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_taurus: In Taurus, the Moon settles into the body. Calm tends to come from food, touch, a familiar room, a steady rhythm. Stability can feel less like a preference and more like a need. Change may unsettle even when it's wanted.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_leo: In Leo, the Moon may need to be seen to feel safe. Validation isn't ego here, it's reassurance. Generosity can be huge; drama may rise when affection feels withheld, and pride can make asking for closeness hard.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_taurus: Likely to be loyal once settled, and resistant to drama. May take time to open, but rarely halfway.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_aries: Excitement may matter more than security here. Likely to bring energy and play; can need to learn that some loves grow slowly without dying.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_gemini: Likely to fall in love through conversation first. Wants someone who keeps the chat alive. Boredom is a real risk; deep silence may be harder than novelty.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_venus_cancer: Vulnerability is often the love language here. Closeness can feel like being known, not just liked. Past hurts may linger; patience tends to read as proof.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_leo: Pursuit can be open and proud. Wants to be wanted out loud — small private affection alone may not feel like enough.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_aries: Pursuit can be passionate but impatient. More likely to chase than to wait. May appreciate a partner who matches the pace rather than tries to slow it.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_taurus: Pursuit tends to be patient and grounded. Likely to want a partner who is present in body, not just in promises. Stubbornness can be loyalty's shadow side.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_mars_cancer: More likely to fight for the bond than for the spotlight. Wants partners who feel emotionally safe to argue with. Withdrawal can be a defense; words tend to help.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_cancer: Closeness can feel like oxygen here. Wants to be remembered, fed, taken care of — and gives those things back generously.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_aries: Closeness can feel like permission to be honest, even when it's spiky. May need partners who don't punish quickness or read silence as ending; the mood tends to rotate.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_taurus: Closeness can anchor through routine — a shared meal, a regular hour, a body next to yours. Wants partners who don't disrupt rest. Slow to leave, slow to forgive being rushed.
webApp.natalPlanetDatingLens_moon_leo: May want love that lights up a room, not love that hides in corners. Loyalty can run deep when felt. Sulks may follow being underestimated.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_aries: In Aries, the Sun can show identity as fast-moving and direct. This placement often tends to lead by going first, push against limits, and gain energy from new starts. Stillness may feel harder than action.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_taurus: In Taurus, the Sun can show a steady, grounded identity. This placement often moves through life with patience, loyalty, and a strong instinct for what feels safe, beautiful, and worth building over time.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_gemini: In Gemini, the Sun can show identity through curiosity. This placement often keeps several interests live at once, learns by talking it out, and tends to feel most itself in a fast, flexible exchange.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_cancer: In Cancer, the Sun can show identity rooted in feeling. This placement often tends to lead with care, protect what matters, and find direction by tending to people and places that feel like home.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_leo: In Leo, the Sun is at home. Identity can run warm and generous, often drawn to being seen, creating moments, and putting heart into what it touches. May need real applause, not polite nods.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_virgo: In Virgo, the Sun can show identity through usefulness and craft. This placement often refines, problem-solves, and tends to feel most itself when work feels precise and meaningful — not just busy.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_libra: In Libra, the Sun can show identity through relationship. This placement often moves through life by reading the room, finding fair ground, and tends to value beauty, balance, and being chosen by people of substance.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_scorpio: In Scorpio, the Sun can show identity that runs deep. This placement often tends toward intensity, privacy, and the quiet kind of power that comes from knowing what it really wants without needing to broadcast it.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_sagittarius: In Sagittarius, the Sun can show identity built around freedom and meaning. This placement often tends to chase the bigger view, blunt honesty, and the next thing on the horizon.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_capricorn: In Capricorn, the Sun can show identity through building. This placement often plays the long game, takes responsibility seriously, and tends to feel most itself when the work compounds into something solid.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_aquarius: In Aquarius, the Sun can show identity through difference. This placement often thinks sideways from the crowd, holds independence as core, and tends to feel most itself among people who don't need it to fit in.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_sun_pisces: In Pisces, the Sun can show identity that's permeable. This placement often picks up moods easily, gravitates to creative and caring spaces, and tends to find self through what it imagines, makes, or feels.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_gemini: In Gemini, the Moon often processes feelings by talking them through. Mood may shift quickly with whoever's near; curiosity can soothe more than reassurance. Restlessness may rise when emotions ask to sit still.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_virgo: In Virgo, the Moon often soothes through order — a clean kitchen, a useful list, a problem solved. Care may show up as practical help. Self-criticism can be the quiet weather here; precision sometimes turns inward.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_libra: In Libra, the Moon often feels best in fair, harmonious company. Conflict may register as physical discomfort; alone time can feel less restful than time with a calm person. Decisions may be slower because feelings need balance first.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_scorpio: In Scorpio, the Moon tends to feel everything in layers. Emotions can be private, intense, and slow to leave. May need full trust before fully showing up — and may remember exactly who earned it.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_sagittarius: In Sagittarius, the Moon often needs room to breathe. Travel, ideas, and a sense of forward motion can be as soothing as comfort food. Feelings may be processed by reframing them into a bigger picture.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_capricorn: In Capricorn, the Moon often manages feelings by managing them. Control can feel safer than expression; competence can feel like home. May take a while to learn that needing comfort isn't a weakness.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_aquarius: In Aquarius, the Moon often steps back from feelings before stepping into them. Space matters; closeness may feel safer once it doesn't require constant proximity. Friendship can be a real form of love.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_moon_pisces: In Pisces, the Moon often soaks up everything in the room. Art, water, music, dreams can act like medicine. May need solo time to figure out which feelings are actually theirs.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_aries: With Aries Rising, you may come across as direct, sparky, and ready. People often read this placement as a leader or an instigator. Tends to walk into rooms looking like there's already a plan.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_gemini: With Gemini Rising, you may come across as curious, quick, and approachable. People often feel easy to talk to with this placement near them. Tends to read the room fast and respond faster.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_cancer: With Cancer Rising, you may come across as gentle, attentive, and a little guarded. People often feel taken care of around this placement. Tends to scan for safety before fully showing up.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_leo: With Leo Rising, you may come across as warm, magnetic, and confident in your own light. People often look toward this placement without meaning to. Tends to leave a clear impression.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_virgo: With Virgo Rising, you may come across as composed, observant, and thoughtful. People often feel quietly assessed in the first few minutes. Tends to look like someone who notices everything.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_libra: With Libra Rising, you may come across as poised, charming, and considerate. People often feel met halfway by this placement. Tends to look like someone who's already weighing things.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_scorpio: With Scorpio Rising, you may come across as intense, private, and hard to read. People often feel something below the surface. Tends to make others choose: come closer or stay back.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_sagittarius: With Sagittarius Rising, you may come across as open, candid, and ready for the next thing. People often feel energized by this placement. Tends to look like someone who would say yes to a long drive.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_capricorn: With Capricorn Rising, you may come across as serious, capable, and a little reserved. People often assume responsibility lives well here. Tends to look like someone who keeps their word.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_aquarius: With Aquarius Rising, you may come across as distinctive, friendly, and a little outside the script. People often clock you as 'the different one' fast. Tends to look like someone who thinks for themselves.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_rising_pisces: With Pisces Rising, you may come across as soft, dreamy, and emotionally available. People often feel the empathy before they hear the words. Tends to look like someone who feels their way through rooms.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_virgo: In Virgo, Mercury tends to think precisely. Edits before speaking, notices what others overlook, and often prefers accuracy over rhetoric. May ask 'what do you mean exactly' more than most.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_libra: In Libra, Mercury tends to think in relationship — what fits the conversation, what keeps it fair. Decisions may slow down to weigh both sides. Often charming, but sometimes hard to pin to a single answer.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_scorpio: In Scorpio, Mercury tends to think under the surface. Asks the real question, reads what isn't said, and may keep its own thoughts private until trust is earned.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_sagittarius: In Sagittarius, Mercury tends to think in big-picture moves. Speaks plainly, sometimes too plainly. The mind may chase meaning over detail; small print can be where things slip.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_aquarius: In Aquarius, Mercury tends to think in patterns — what's the system, what's the exception. Curious about ideas more than gossip; may sound detached when actually deeply engaged.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_mercury_pisces: In Pisces, Mercury tends to think in images, feelings, and metaphor. Words may arrive sideways, through stories. Tends to listen for tone first, content second.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_virgo: In Virgo, Venus loves through small, useful gestures. Affection may show up as remembering details, fixing things, showing up on time. May be slower to declare feelings — sometimes mistaken for cool.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_venus_pisces: In Pisces, Venus loves with imagination and devotion. Tends to fall in deeply, and may sometimes love the dream as much as the person. Vulnerability is the door.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_leo: In Leo, Jupiter expands through creativity and confidence. Tends to grow by being bold in love and self-expression. Generosity may be lavish; ego can be the watch-out.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_scorpio: In Scorpio, Jupiter expands through depth. Tends to grow through honest emotional work — what's been hidden, what's been transformed. Power may come with stewardship.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_sagittarius: In Sagittarius, Jupiter is at home. Tends to grow through travel, study, belief, and chasing meaning. Optimism runs strong; risk tolerance can run high.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_capricorn: In Capricorn, Jupiter expands slowly and lastingly. Tends to grow by building structures that hold weight. Patience is the medicine and often the reward.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_aquarius: In Aquarius, Jupiter expands through groups, ideas, and the future. Tends to grow by joining or building something larger than itself. Independence is part of the gift.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_jupiter_pisces: In Pisces, Jupiter expands through compassion and imagination. Tends to grow through art, faith, and time near water. Boundaries may need extra care so the gift doesn't drain.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_gemini: In Gemini, Saturn often asks the mind to commit. Lessons can show up around finishing what was started, choosing depth, and not hiding behind cleverness.

webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_virgo: In Virgo, Saturn often asks for healthy work. Lessons can show up around perfectionism, service that drains, and learning when 'good' is actually enough.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_libra: In Libra, Saturn often asks for fair relationships. Lessons can show up around boundaries, commitment, and the harder side of partnership. Real love may need real structure.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_scorpio: In Scorpio, Saturn makes depth the assignment. Lessons can show up around control, trust, and what is held too tightly. Power tends to mature through letting go.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_sagittarius: In Sagittarius, Saturn often asks for grounded belief. Lessons can show up around what you say you believe versus what you live. Faith may need follow-through.
webApp.natalPlanetIn_saturn_capricorn: In Capricorn, Saturn is at home. Lessons can show up around ambition, authority, and what real success costs. The reward tends to be durable.

webApp.natalChartFeaturedInsightsBody: A closer read on a few of your placements. We're adding more interpretations every release.
webApp.natalChartHousesBody: Each house describes a life area. The sign sitting on each house cusp colors how that area unfolds — which is why two charts with the same Sun sign can still feel very different.

webApp.natalHouseMeaning_2: Money, possessions, values, what feels safe and earned.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_3: Communication, siblings, daily learning, your immediate world.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_4: Home, family, roots, emotional foundation, private life.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_6: Daily routine, work, health, the small habits that compound.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_7: One-on-one partnerships, mirrors, the people you sign on with.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_8: Shared resources, intimacy, transformation, what's hidden but real.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_9: Travel, philosophy, higher learning, the search for meaning.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_10: Career, public image, achievement, your visible role in the world.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_11: Friends, groups, long-term hopes, the future you're building toward.
webApp.natalHouseMeaning_12: Solitude, dreams, what's behind the curtain, surrender.

webApp.synastryScoreBody_exceptional: This score suggests an unusually easy overlap between core needs, attraction, and communication. Treat it as an invitation to go deeper — not as a guarantee.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_strong: There is a clear sense of mutual rhythm here. The connection may feel easier to read, with enough shared language to support deeper conversations.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_promising: This score points to real overlap, with a few areas that may need curiosity instead of assumption. Start with what feels easy, then ask about what feels different.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_mixed: There is meaningful potential here, but the charts may move at different speeds. This kind of dynamic benefits from clear communication and slower assumptions.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_growth: This score suggests the connection may ask for more patience, translation, and emotional clarity. It can still be valuable if both people stay curious.
webApp.synastryScoreBody_different: Your charts may approach closeness, timing, or communication differently. Treat the score as a prompt to ask better questions, not as a reason to dismiss someone.

webApp.luckyDaysV2Subtitle: A symbolic monthly rhythm for reflection, connection, and intention.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensConnectBody: This month is a good frame for connection. Reach out without an agenda, hold the conversation a beat longer than usual, and let someone in slightly more than your default. Connection isn't a transaction; it's a rhythm.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensReflectBody: Use this month to notice patterns rather than just react to events. The same situation showing up twice is data; three times is a pattern. Journal, talk to a real friend, or sit quietly long enough to hear yourself.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensResetBody: This month carries room for a soft reset — a routine swapped, a habit retired, a small piece of life put back in order. Don't aim for transformation; aim for one thing that's slightly less heavy by month's end.
webApp.luckyDaysV2LensPlanBody: Use this month to plan in months, not days. What do the next 90 days want from you? Where do you need to be by then? Plan in arcs and intentions, not in to-do items.
webApp.luckyDaysV2DisclaimerBody: These are planning windows for reflection, not lucky dates. Astrology works best as a pattern language, not a guarantee.

webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_aries: Use the early days for one bold first move. Start before second-guessing. Direction matters more than timing.

webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_gemini: Use the early days to open a few threads — but mark which one is the real one. The rest are scenery.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_cancer: Use the early days to set the emotional temperature. What you protect now tends to hold for the month.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_leo: Use the early days to say something out loud — a creative claim, a feeling, a yes. Visibility builds momentum here.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_virgo: Use the early days to clear what's been dragging. A tidied inbox, a finished task. Small order begets bigger order.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_libra: Use the early days to choose, even slightly. Decisions made now don't have to be perfect — they just have to be made.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_scorpio: Use the early days to identify the real thing you're tracking this month. The surface story is usually not it.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_sagittarius: Use the early days to set the bigger frame. What does this month belong to? Name it before momentum picks up.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_capricorn: Use the early days to plant the structural piece. The thing that holds the rest of the month together.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_aquarius: Use the early days for a slightly different angle. A new lens, a different room, a friend you haven't called.
webApp.luckyDaysEarlyWindowV2_pisces: Use the early days to listen for the month's feeling. What does it want from you? Don't push past the first impression.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_aries: Mid-month asks for follow-through. The fire from week one needs structure now, not more fuel.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_taurus: Mid-month is your home turf — steady, productive, sensory. Let this stretch carry most of your real work.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_gemini: Mid-month asks Gemini to commit, even partially. The fun of choosing is over; the work of staying is here.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_cancer: Mid-month asks for relational maintenance. The check-ins you delay now tend to compound into bigger gaps.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_leo: Mid-month asks Leo to share the spotlight. Generosity reads strongest mid-arc, when the warmth isn't transactional.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_virgo: Mid-month is your peak — strong execution, clean focus. Just don't audit the joy out of it.
webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_libra: Mid-month asks for a real conversation, not a polite one. The kind you've been postponing.

webApp.luckyDaysMidWindowV2_pisces: Mid-month asks for boundaries around the empathy. Care is real here; absorbing other people's stuff is a real risk.

webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_taurus: Late month asks Taurus to release what doesn't actually hold. Not every steady thing is worth keeping; some are just heavy.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_gemini: Late month asks Gemini to close one open loop — the one you've been carrying past its expiry. Closing is also creativity.

webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_virgo: Late month asks Virgo to log the wins, not just the gaps. Calibration only works if you count both sides.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_libra: Late month asks Libra to honor the decisions you made earlier. Don't unwind them now just because they feel uncomfortable.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_scorpio: Late month asks Scorpio for the integration — what did the depth teach? Carry the lesson; release the gravity.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_sagittarius: Late month asks Sagittarius to write it down. The insights are loud while they're fresh; they fade fast.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_capricorn: Late month asks Capricorn to actually rest — not the productive kind. The kind that doesn't optimize anything.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_aquarius: Late month asks Aquarius to reconnect with someone you drifted from. Independence can quietly become isolation.
webApp.luckyDaysLateWindowV2_pisces: Late month asks Pisces to set the closing dream. What does next month want to feel like? Name it gently.

webApp.dateReflectionV2IntentBody: Pick one. The rest of this page adjusts to the kind of moment you're preparing for.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_firstConversation: First conversations work best when you stay genuinely curious. Notice how they describe their day, the small things that make them laugh, the way they ask questions back. You're not auditioning each other — you're listening for whether there's something real to keep exploring.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_firstDate: A first date is mostly about presence. Pay attention to the energy between sentences, not just the words. Does the conversation feel easy or effortful? Are you both relaxing as the time passes, or trying harder? Those signals tell you more than any clever question.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_reconnect: Reconnecting asks for honesty about what changed. Notice what they bring up first — and what they avoid. The goal isn't to pick up exactly where things left off; it's to meet who each of you has become since.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Lens_deepen: Deepening a bond happens slowly. Pay attention to the moments they share something a little more vulnerable, and to how you respond. Slowing down, asking a real follow-up, choosing curiosity over reassurance — those are the moves that actually deepen things.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_firstConversation: Don't try to make the first conversation prove anything. You don't have to be clever, charming, or memorable on demand. Forcing chemistry into a chat thread almost always reads as effortful — and the right person won't need you to perform.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_firstDate: Resist the urge to lock in a verdict by the end of the date. First dates are usually quieter than the stories we tell about them. Let it be incomplete. You don't have to know if you're "in" yet — you just have to know if you'd like to keep talking.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_reconnect: Don't pretend the gap didn't happen. Skipping past it to recreate the old version of the connection rarely works. Acknowledge that things shifted, even briefly, and let the new version of the conversation breathe.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Avoid_deepen: Don't push for closeness on a timeline. Deepening isn't a milestone you hit by saying the right serious thing — it's the byproduct of consistent, honest, unhurried attention. If it feels forced, it probably is.

webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_firstDate_3: When do you feel most at home in your own life?

webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_reconnect_2: What did you actually want from our last chapter, looking back?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_reconnect_3: What would feel honest to name between us before we keep going?

webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_deepen_2: When do you feel closest to me — and when do you feel further away?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Prompts_deepen_3: What does care look like for you, in the small everyday ways?
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_1: Send a short voice note before you meet — your voice carries warmth that text strips out.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_2: Trade a song or a podcast you've actually been listening to this week.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstConversation_3: Ask one open question and let your reply be longer than a sentence. Set the pace.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_1: A walk and a coffee. Movement keeps silences from feeling heavy, and you can extend or end it naturally.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_2: A quiet drink at a low-key spot. Bonus points if the place doesn't require shouting.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_firstDate_3: A small bookstore or a tiny gallery — something to react to together so the conversation doesn't have to carry every minute.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_1: A simple lunch instead of a candlelit dinner. Lower the stakes; let the conversation set the temperature.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_2: A long walk in a familiar place. Familiar settings make honest conversations easier.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_reconnect_3: A shared playlist before you meet. It gives you something to listen for in each other again.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_1: Cook one part of a meal together. Doing something with your hands invites the slower kind of talking.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_2: A no-phones evening. One agreed hour where you're both fully here.
webApp.dateReflectionV2Idea_deepen_3: Share one thing each that's felt heavy this week, with no fix expected. Just witness it.
webApp.dateReflectionV2BoundariesBody: A good date still needs consent, curiosity, and room for both people to change their mind. None of these prompts or ideas are a script — read the moment you're in, and let either of you stop or shift the plan without explaining.
webApp.dateReflectionV2DisclaimerBody: Use this as a reflection tool, not a prediction. The best timing is still the one both people choose freely.

webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_aries: Across this month Aries tends to feel the engine before the destination — there's energy looking for something real to commit to. The pattern often rewards picking one direction and staying with it past the first dip in motivation. Speed is not the gift here; chosen speed is. Where you keep starting and dropping, the month asks for one project, one person, one promise that you actually finish.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_taurus: This month tends to move Taurus in slow circles — building, settling, refining, settling deeper. The rhythm rewards staying with what's already in your hands rather than chasing the next thing. Comfort isn't laziness here; it's information about what your body can sustain. The pattern often quietly asks: what do you keep, and what have you been holding only out of habit?
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_gemini: Gemini's month often opens with many possible doors — conversations, half-projects, ideas that want air. The shape of the month tends to favor closing some of them on purpose so the remaining ones can deepen. Variety stays a strength; scattered isn't the same as curious. The pattern asks where breadth has quietly become a way of not committing.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_cancer: This month tends to move Cancer toward the people, places, and rituals that genuinely feel like home. The arc often favors building inward before reaching outward — sleep, kitchen, close circle, slow conversation. Sensitivity is a tool here, not a leak. The pattern asks who in your life gets your softest version, and whether you're giving it where it actually nourishes you back.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_leo: Leo's month often runs warmer than usual — there's a pull to be seen, to make, to gather people. The pattern tends to land best when generosity is the leading note and applause is just the echo. Recognition matters; it just doesn't need to be earned twice. The arc asks where you're performing warmth versus where you're simply being warm.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_virgo: Virgo's month tends to favor careful editing over big new launches — the systems already in motion want refining, not replacing. Precision is the gift; perfectionism is the tax. The pattern often rewards finishing the unfinished rather than designing the next plan. Where you've been polishing the same thing for weeks, the month asks if it's already done.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_libra: Libra's month often holds a quiet choice underneath the easy days — something you've been keeping balanced may want a small decision. The pattern rewards picking gently and on time rather than waiting for the option that costs nothing. Diplomacy stays a real strength; deferral is its shadow. The arc asks which 'maybe' has quietly become a 'no.'
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_scorpio: This month tends to move Scorpio toward what's been simmering beneath the surface — a feeling, a truth, a closeness that's been waiting. The pattern often rewards saying the layer underneath rather than guarding it. Depth lands here; depth withheld tends to pressurize. The arc asks where honesty would loosen the room you're in.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_sagittarius: Sagittarius's month often reaches wide — for travel, ideas, the bigger frame. The rhythm rewards balancing that reach with staying long enough to see something through with the people in front of you. Freedom isn't threatened by presence. The pattern asks which horizon you're chasing to avoid the closer one.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_capricorn: Capricorn's month tends to favor patient building over visible proof — the work that compounds quietly may matter more than the milestone everyone sees. The pattern rewards trusting the long arc and resting inside it. Competence stays a real currency; over-functioning isn't the same as commitment. The arc asks what you're carrying that someone else could.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_aquarius: Aquarius's month often invites a small step toward people, not away — independence stays intact, and closeness doesn't undo it. The pattern rewards letting someone see the part of you that doesn't usually get shown. Originality is a real gift; distance can quietly become a habit dressed as identity. The arc asks where you'd rather be a little closer.
webApp.monthlyHoroscopeLensV2_pisces: Pisces's month tends to run on inner tides — strong intuitions, soft edges, and a sensitivity to whose mood is in the room. The pattern often rewards staying in your own water and noticing where someone else's feelings end and yours begin. Empathy is the gift; absorption is its shadow. The arc asks what you need to set down before tonight.
